subject: POC trial: RACI and stakeholder mapping - Summit Health
messages:
From: James Patel <j.patel@summithealth.org>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com; lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com; procurement@summithealth.org
Date: 2027-05-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC trial: RACI and stakeholder mapping - Summit Health

Hi Marissa / team,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — super helpful. As discussed on the call, we want to move forward with a 4-week POC to validate latency, cost, and integration with our clinical search workflows. To keep things moving I put together the high-level success criteria below and a rough timeline. Can you confirm ownership for infra, app integration, security review, and procurement so we can lock internal resources?

High-level success criteria (internal):
- End-to-end query latency < 300ms at 95th percentile for 8-token prompts
- Cost projection within 20% of the estimate in the quote
- Integration with our search API (FHIR + custom ranking) completed in staging
- No P1 security gaps identified in the security checklist

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize scope & RACI, sign MSA/SoW for trial access
- Week 1: infra provisioning + model selection + smoke tests
- Week 2: integration + performance tuning
- Week 3: evaluation & regression tests; collect metrics + feedback
- Week 4: review findings + go/no-go decision

Internal owners (TBD):
- Infra / cloud provisioning: ?
- App integration (search team): ?
- Security / compliance review: ?
- Procurement / contract: ?

Can you send a short RACI (who is Responsible / Accountable / Consulted / Informed) and any docs you need from procurement/security to start? I can loop our Legal and Infra once we have names.

Best,
James
Director, Search Engineering
Summit Health
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: James Patel <j.patel@summithealth.org>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com; aditya_rao@redwood.com; procurement@summithealth.org
Date: 2027-05-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial: RACI and stakeholder mapping - Summit Health

Hi James — thanks for the clear recap and timeline. Really excited to run this with Summit Health. Per your ask, attached is a starter RACI spreadsheet and a draft success criteria doc that mirrors what you outlined. Quick responses inline below and next steps at the bottom.

Inline:
- Infra / cloud provisioning: Marissa Cole (Redwood AM) will coordinate with your infra owner to provision dedicated trial capacity.
- App integration (search team): Laurel (cc'd) will own the integration work and point you to the integration guide.
- Security / compliance review: Aditya (cc'd) will lead the security questionnaire & SCOC items; he may reach out for a short call.
- Procurement / contract: Please loop your procurement alias (procurement@summithealth.org). For the POC we typically proceed with a short SoW + trial access; Legal can follow if the SoW needs changes.

Next steps (proposed):
1) James to confirm the internal names for app infra + security on your side (if different from procurement alias).
2) Redwood to share RACI + success criteria (attached) and a simple SoW/RoF for trial access.
3) Procurement to confirm PO or sign SoW (procurement contact) — Marissa will follow up if we need a contract redline.
4) Schedule a 30-min kickoff this week to align on test data and staging endpoints.

Attachments: summit_raci_draft.xlsx, poc_success_criteria.docx

If that all looks good I can schedule the kickoff for Thu or Fri — what works for your team?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: James Patel <j.patel@summithealth.org>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com; procurement@summithealth.org
Date: 2027-05-12T12:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial: RACI and stakeholder mapping - Summit Health

Thanks James — Laurel here (Engineering lead for integrations). A couple clarifications on ownership from Redwood's side and what we'll need from Summit: 

Redwood ownership (proposed RACI highlights):
- Responsible (R) — Integration tasks, data mapping, SDK changes: lauren_bishop@redwood.com (Integration Lead)
- Accountable (A) — Overall delivery of integration milestones: marissa_cole@redwood.com (Redwood AE)
- Consulted (C) — Performance tuning / model ops: aditya_rao@redwood.com (Infra/ML Ops)
- Informed (I) — Procurement/legal/status updates: procurement@summithealth.org

What we need from Summit this week:
- App owner for the search team to be the day-to-day contact for integration tasks (name + email).
- Staging API keys and an anonymized sample of typical queries (or a synthetic set that mirrors token lengths and cardinality).
- Security contact for the SOC2 checklist so Aditya can send the questionnaire and schedule a 30-min security sync (if needed).

I'll also attach a short integration checklist in the RACI spreadsheet and flag the items that tend to take the longest (data mapping and ranking tests).

From an infra perspective: Aditya (cc) — we'll need a staging endpoint (VPC peering or IP allowlist) and estimate of concurrent QPS to size the trial capacity. Could you confirm expected concurrency on Summit's side?

Thanks — I can be on the kickoff; Thu 3:00pm PT or Fri 10:00am PT works for me.

—Lauren
Senior Integration Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Gomez <a.gomez@summithealth.org>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com; lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: James Patel <j.patel@summithealth.org>; procurement@summithealth.org
Date: 2027-05-12T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial: RACI and stakeholder mapping - Summit Health

Hi Marissa / Lauren — thanks for the fast follow-up and the RACI starter. Confirming owners from Summit:

- App owner (Responsible): Miguel Santos <m.santos@summithealth.org> (Search Team Lead)
- Infra (Consulted): Priya Natarajan <p.natarajan@summithealth.org> (Cloud Ops) — she will help with VPC peering and IP allowlist
- Security / compliance (Accountable): Alicia Gomez <a.gomez@summithealth.org> (Security Manager) — I will coordinate the SOC2 checklist and legal questions
- Procurement (Informed/PO): procurement@summithealth.org — primary contact is procurement lead Carla Lin (carla.lin@summithealth.org)

We can do the kickoff on Thu at 3:00pm PT. For concurrency — we expect a staging QPS of ~8-12 for the trial workload. I'll upload an anonymized sample query set to the Drive folder and share access to Miguel and Priya.

I'll also accept the RACI and SoW as starters; procurement will review the SoW and follow up on PO path.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Security Manager | Summit Health
